Star Products

Crawler Type Mobile Crushing Plant

SREW Crawler Tracked Mobile Crushing Plant is a highly automated, extreme-efficiency crushing plant built for massive mobility, heavy fabrication durability, and state-of-the-art intelligent PLC control.

More Specs Inquire Now

Precision Crushing

Equipped with a high-capacity cone crusher with excellent performance suitable for medium and fine crushing, special crushing wall and concave design, supplemented by curved cavity and hydraulic cavity clearing system, improve the crushing efficiency and effectively reduce the easy operation loss.

Intelligent Overload Protection

It adopts a fully automatic crushing control system, which quickly responds to iron (overload) and automatically releases reset protection to ensure continuous, stable, and efficient production.

Intelligent Cavity Control

It is equipped with a PLC control system to keep full cavity continuous feeding, reasonable configuration, a smooth process, high production efficiency, good product shape, and the final product is a high-quality cube.

High-Performance Crushing

Large eccentricity, high swing frequency, and layer compression crushing make the equipment have a high capacity, large reduction ratio, and a good grain shape.

Engineered For Maximum Yield & Reliability

S R ENGG WORKS (SREW) is a premier manufacturer dedicated to heavy-duty industrial fabrication and precision engineering. We specialize in the end-to-end design, proprietary manufacturing, and turnkey installation of high-capacity crushing, screening, sand processing, and material handling plants.

Serving top-tier operators across the mining, aggregate, infrastructure, and heavy recycling sectors, SREW plants are built to rigorous global standards—delivering uncompromising operational uptime, superior metallurgical durability, and precise material shaping.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about S R ENGG WORKS and our solutions

What is SREW's core expertise?

SREW specializes in design, manufacturing, and turnkey installation of high-capacity crushing, screening, and material handling plants.

What are your plant capacities?

We engineer modular plants with capacities ranging from 30 TPH to 800 TPH, customized for mining, aggregate, and C&D recycling.

Where is S R ENGG WORKS located?

Our manufacturing facility and headquarters are located in IDA Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, Telangana, serving clients globally.

What industries do you serve?

We serve Mining, Construction, Infrastructure, and C&D Waste Recycling sectors with precision engineering solutions.

Do you provide turnkey solutions?

Yes, we offer complete turnkey services including plant design, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and support.

Is SREW an ISO certified company?

Yes, S R ENGG WORKS is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, ensuring international quality and manufacturing standards.

What equipment do you manufacture?

We produce Jaw Crushers, Cone Crushers, VSI, Vibrating Screens, Grizzly Feeders, Sand Dryers, Silos, and PLC Control Panels.

Do you handle recycling projects?

We specialize in Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste recycling plants, promoting sustainable material management.

How can I request a brochure?

You can download our company profile and product brochures directly using the "Download Brochure" button on our website.

Ready to discuss your project requirements?

Our team of experts is ready to help you find the perfect solution for your needs.
